description: This file defines the Weights class responsible for managing graph weights, including loading, accessing, modifying, and validating weights, constants, and associated metadata within the torch::nativert namespace.

classes.name: Weights
classes.description: Class managing graph weights, including loading, access, modification, validation, and constants management.

methods.name: at
methods.description: Returns the tensor associated with the given name.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a weight with the given name exists.

methods.name: loadStateDict
methods.description: Loads weights from a provided state dictionary.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Replaces the value stored at the specified weight name.

methods.name: updateValue
methods.description: Updates the value of a weight in-place.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Validates a new weight value against criteria.

methods.name: updateFoldedConst
methods.description: Updates a folded constant with a new tensor value.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the weights object.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the version number of the weights instance.
